entries.clue: Estate let for a lump sum yearly was said to be held at this
Wiltshire hill where the land's great men submitted to William in 1086
Antipodean milk coffee, smoother than a cappuccino and barely capped in foam.
Flick the switch and it rumbles up to the boil, then clicks off
Bitter Seville preserve, shreds of peel suspended in gold
Butcher's word for one slice off a cured pig's side, curling as it fries
Single measure of espresso, ordered double by anyone flagging.
Ring of dough boiled before baking, split and filled with soft cheese
Four roods to one, the measure the mowing ground was entered in
Free second serving into the same cup, offered by kind cafes
Plastic cap clicked on so the drink survives a bus journey
What a holding owed in kind: honey, eels, loaves, a hawk
